body:
## Context

The current onboarding issue/comment is functional, but the user-facing copy is noisy and not focused on the actual remaining setup tasks.

Example current output:

- Issue title: `Sepo setup check`
- Issue body includes test commands immediately.
- Status comment includes:
  - `GitHub auth resolved: oidc_broker`
  - `Agent provider resolved: not configured`
  - raw booleans for `OPENAI_API_KEY` / `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`
  - memory/rubrics branch checks
  - a full built-in trigger labels inventory
  - generic next steps

This is hard to scan. The built-in trigger label inventory is especially noisy and does not need to be shown in onboarding.

## Goal

Improve the onboarding setup issue UX while keeping the behavior idempotent.

Keep the issue title:

```text
Sepo setup check
```

But make the setup issue/comment clearer:

1. The issue body should be short and stable.
2. The status comment should focus on:
   - GitHub App/auth status
   - model provider credentials
   - memory/rubrics initialization
   - remaining todos
   - commands to test installation
3. Remove the built-in trigger labels inventory from the onboarding comment.

The code should still ensure built-in labels exist; only remove that inventory from the user-facing status comment.

## Suggested issue body

Use a short body, for example:

```md
Use this issue to track Sepo setup for this repository.

The latest setup status is maintained in the comment below.
```

## Suggested status comment shape

Keep the hidden marker:

```html
<!-- sepo-agent-onboarding-check -->
```

Then render something like:

```md
## Sepo setup status

### Current status

- [x] GitHub App/auth: Sepo GitHub App installed and resolved through OIDC broker
- [ ] Model credentials: not configured
  - Add one of:
    - `OPENAI_API_KEY`
    - `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`
  - Optional: configure `AGENT_DEFAULT_PROVIDER`
- [ ] Memory: not initialized
  - Run **Actions → Agent / Memory / Initialization**
- [ ] Rubrics: not initialized
  - Optional: run **Actions → Agent / Rubrics / Initialization**

### Remaining setup

- [ ] Configure one model provider credential
- [ ] Initialize memory branch `agent/memory`
- [ ] Optional: initialize rubrics branch `agent/rubrics`

### Test Sepo

After setup, try:

```md
@sepo-agent /answer Is Sepo configured correctly in this repository?
```

Try implementation:

```md
@sepo-agent /implement Create a small README update that verifies the agent can open a PR.
```

On an open pull request:

```md
@sepo-agent /review
```

Last checked: <run url>
```

## Conditional rendering details

### GitHub auth

If `authMode` is set, show a friendly line such as:

```md
- [x] GitHub App/auth: resolved via `oidc_broker`
```

If it is missing, show a clear todo.

### Model provider credentials

If neither provider credential is configured, show:

```md
- [ ] Model credentials: not configured
  - Add one of `OPENAI_API_KEY` or `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` as a repository secret.
```

If one is configured, show only the one that is set, for example:

```md
- [x] Model credentials: `OPENAI_API_KEY` configured
```

If both are configured:

```md
- [x] Model credentials: `OPENAI_API_KEY` and `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` configured
```

Optionally mention the resolved provider:

```md
- Agent provider: `openai` (`AGENT_DEFAULT_PROVIDER` or auto-resolution reason)
```

### Memory and rubrics

If the memory branch exists:

```md
- [x] Memory: initialized (`agent/memory`)
```

If missing:

```md
- [ ] Memory: not initialized
  - Run **Actions → Agent / Memory / Initialization**.
```

If the rubrics branch exists:

```md
- [x] Rubrics: initialized (`agent/rubrics`)
```

If missing:

```md
- [ ] Rubrics: not initialized
  - Optional: run **Actions → Agent / Rubrics / Initialization**.
```

### Remaining setup

Only list incomplete items. For example:

- missing provider credential
- missing memory branch
- optional missing rubrics branch

If everything important is ready, show a success message instead of a long todo list.

### Test commands

Move the `/answer`, `/implement`, and `/review` commands into the status comment under a `Test Sepo` section.

## Files likely involved

```text
.agent/src/onboarding.ts
.agent/src/__tests__/onboarding-check-cli.test.ts
```

Potentially docs if any tests/docs assert the old onboarding text.

## Acceptance criteria

- `Sepo setup check` issue title remains unchanged.
- Onboarding still creates/reuses one setup issue.
- Onboarding still posts/updates one marked status comment with `<!-- sepo-agent-onboarding-check -->`.
- Built-in trigger labels are still ensured by code.
- Built-in trigger label inventory is no longer shown in the onboarding comment.
- Provider credential status is rendered in friendly, conditional language.
- Memory/rubrics status is rendered in friendly, conditional language with action names to run when missing.
- Test commands are included under a clear `Test Sepo` section.
- Tests are updated to cover the new rendered copy.

Implemented the onboarding UX cleanup.

Changed:
- [`.agent/src/onboarding.ts`](.agent/src/onboarding.ts)
  - Kept `Sepo setup check` title.
  - Replaced issue body with short stable setup-tracking copy.
  - Moved `/answer`, `/implement`, and `/review` examples into the marked status comment.
  - Removed the built-in trigger label inventory from the user-facing comment.
  - Kept built-in label creation unchanged.
  - Added friendly conditional rendering for auth, model credentials, provider resolution, memory, rubrics, and remaining setup.

- [`.agent/src/__tests__/onboarding-check-cli.test.ts`](.agent/src/__tests__/onboarding-check-cli.test.ts)
  - Tests now inspect the actual generated issue/comment bodies.
  - Covered short issue body, marked status comment, friendly provider/memory/rubrics copy, test commands, idempotent comment update, and absence of label inventory.

Verification:
- `node --test dist/__tests__/onboarding-check-cli.test.js` passed.
- `npm test` passed: 515 tests.

I implemented it in these files in the prior implementation workspace:

- [`.agent/src/onboarding.ts`](.agent/src/onboarding.ts)  
  Main onboarding renderer: short issue body, new status comment sections, conditional provider/memory/rubrics copy, removed visible trigger-label inventory while keeping label creation.

- [`.agent/src/__tests__/onboarding-check-cli.test.ts`](.agent/src/__tests__/onboarding-check-cli.test.ts)  
  Tests for the new issue body/comment text, idempotent marker comment update, continued label creation, and absence of the trigger-label inventory.

Important: this current `/answer` runner checkout is clean on `main`, and those files still show the old onboarding strings (`Try a basic answer run`, `Built-in trigger labels:`). So the previous implementation was not present in this current checkout/branch.
@sepo-agent can you implement it with orchestrator

I triaged this as a `implement` request.

I’ll implement the onboarding UX cleanup through the implementation workflow, using the issue details as the spec.

Reply with:

```text
@sepo-agent /approve req-08032d
```

to start the implementation workflow.

<!-- sepo-agent-request base64: -->

| Approved by | Action | Tracking |
|---|---|---|
| @lolipopshock | `implement` via `agent-implement.yml` | [approval run](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/actions/runs/25693329391) |

<!-- sepo-agent-approved -->

**Sepo implementation finished**

- Branch: `agent/implement-issue-212/codex-25693342251`
- Pull request: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/215
- Approval: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/212#issuecomment-4424370269

Updated onboarding setup to use a short stable issue body and a focused marked status comment with friendly auth, model credential, memory, rubrics, remaining setup, and test-command sections while keeping built-in label creation. Updated CLI coverage and install docs; verified with `npm run build`, `node --test dist/__tests__/onboarding-check-cli.test.js`, and `git diff --check`.

title: Improve onboarding setup issue UX
